verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a contract lifecycle management platform covering contract creation, signing, storage, workflows, APIs and webhooks. Filing state annual reports and franchise tax is a registered-agent and entity-compliance capability outside that product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Ironclad offers any state-filing or tax-compliance feature that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As a founder, I can file annual reports and franchise tax on time through the platform
